newsitem.title: UK: Million UK factory jobs lost under Tories - Labour.
newsitem.headline: Million UK factory jobs lost under Tories - Labour.

text.p: The number of manufacturing jobs in Britain has fallen by more than a million over the last 13 years, the opposition Labour Party said on Friday.
And it pointed an accusing finger at the Conservative government.
"Conservative policies have destroyed the jobs of millions of the working people the Tories now have the cheek to ask for support," said Ian McCartney, Labour's chief employment spokesman.
He said the government's own figures showed employment in British manufacturing dropped from 5,079,000 in March 1983 to 3,819,000 in March 1996.
"Across the economy, there are still one million fewer people in work than there were in 1990," McCartney said.

In the 13 years since 1983, manufacturing employment fell in all but one part of Britain, the figures showed, with the South East suffering most. There, the number of factory jobs fell from 1,426,000 in 1983 to 578,000 in 1996.
